parameters.name: name
parameters.doc: The step's name. It becomes the step's template in the pipeline, its `steps/<folder>` (hyphens as underscores) and its image, so use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, with no hyphen at the start or end, for example `model-evaluation`. Every step needs its own name.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.doc: What the step is. Required. The platform labels the step with it and offers only the compute classes that fit the kind.

values.label: "transform"
values.doc: Turns data into other data: preprocess, filter, split, convert.

values.label: "evaluate"
values.doc: Measures a model or a dataset.

values.label: "control"
values.doc: Decides or coordinates; does no data work itself.

parameters.name: reads
parameters.doc: The config sections the step reads (the files and folders of `config/`, for example `"train"`). A section that does not exist is refused when the pipeline is rendered.

parameters.name: inputs
parameters.doc: The names of the config values that hold a dataset reference, for example `"dataset"` for `dataset: my-data@latest`. The platform pins each to one exact version when the run starts, and the step reads it with `step.input("dataset")`. Step code never names a version.

parameters.name: needs
parameters.doc: The steps that must finish first. Give the step variables (`needs=[prepare]`), not their names, and define each step above the steps that need it.

parameters.name: produces
parameters.doc: What the step writes: `model("name")`, `artifact("name")` or `dataset("name")`. The step writes each into the folder `step.output("name")` gives it, and `step.result()` saves them.

values.label: [artifact("report")]
values.doc: The step writes files that belong to this run.

values.label: [dataset("clean")]
values.doc: The step writes a version of the dataset `clean`.

parameters.name: gpu
parameters.doc: Run the step on a GPU. Only GPU steps can run on the HPC (Slurm) site, so `walltime` and `resumable` need `gpu=True`.

parameters.name: disk
parameters.doc: Scratch disk the step asks for, as a quantity: digits and an optional Ki, Mi, Gi, Ti, K, M, G or T, for example `"20Gi"`. Set it for steps that need more than the platform's default.

parameters.name: when
parameters.doc: A condition: the step runs only when it is true. A step that needs a conditional step is still started when the conditional step is skipped.

parameters.name: walltime
parameters.doc: The time limit of the step on the HPC (Slurm) site, as minutes or hours in text: `"90m"`, `"12h"` or `"720"` (minutes). Only for `gpu=True` steps. Without it the platform uses 4 hours. A step with a limit above 4 hours should be resumable.

parameters.name: resumable
parameters.doc: Whether the step can continue from a checkpoint after the site stops it. `True` tells the step to save 10 minutes before its time limit; a lead time such as `"20m"` or `"1h"` changes that. `False` says the step never continues. Only for `gpu=True` steps; save with `kaos_lib.checkpoint`.

values.label: True
values.doc: Resumable: the step saves a checkpoint 10 minutes before its time limit.

values.label: False
values.doc: Not resumable: the step is never continued from a checkpoint.

values.label: "20m"
values.doc: Resumable, told to save 20 minutes before its time limit.

values.label: "1h"
values.doc: Resumable, told to save 1 hour before its time limit.

parameters.name: checkpoint_every
parameters.doc: How often the platform copies the step's checkpoint folder (`KAOS_CHECKPOINT_DIR`): minutes such as `"20m"`, `"1h"` or `20`. `False` turns the copies off. GPU steps copy every 10 minutes by default.

values.label: False
values.doc: Do not copy the checkpoint folder.

parameters.name: idle_timeout
parameters.doc: How long a GPU step may show no GPU use and no new log line before the platform ends it as idle: minutes such as `"40m"`, `"1h"` or `40`. The default is 20 minutes. `0` (or `False`) turns the idle limit off, so a hung step keeps its GPU until its time limit.

values.label: "40m"
values.doc: Allow 40 minutes without GPU use or log lines.

values.label: "1h"
values.doc: Allow one hour without GPU use or log lines.
Never end the step as idle.

pipeline.doc: `with pipeline("name") as p:` opens a pipeline; every `step(...)` call inside it adds a step. The check reads these calls without running your code.

rules.name: NotAnalysable
rules.fix: Fix the file so it can be read, then run the check again.

rules.name: MissingKaosLibArg
rules.fix: Add `ARG KAOS_LIB_PACKAGE="kaos-lib[zitadel]==<the version you tested>"` before the install and install with `RUN pip install --no-cache-dir "${KAOS_LIB_PACKAGE}"`.

rules.name: KaosLibNotInstalled
rules.fix: Install it from the argument: `RUN pip install --no-cache-dir "${KAOS_LIB_PACKAGE}"`.

rules.name: WrongArchitecture
rules.fix: Remove `--platform=` from FROM (the build picks the platform's architecture), or use `--platform=$BUILDPLATFORM`.

rules.name: CopyOutsideContext
rules.fix: Copy only files inside the step's folder (the build context). Files of the repository root are available to the compose-and-validate step only.

rules.name: StepContract
rules.fix: Put the step's code in steps/<name>/app/entry.py and start it with `ENTRYPOINT ["python", "-m", "app.entry"]`.

rules.name: HugeLayers
rules.fix: Copy only what the step needs, add --no-cache-dir to pip, and remove /var/lib/apt/lists in the same RUN as apt-get install.

rules.name: RootUser
rules.fix: Add `RUN useradd --create-home app` and `USER app` before the ENTRYPOINT if your step does not need root.

rules.name: NoCudaForGpuStep
rules.fix: Use a CUDA-enabled base image, or depend on a library whose wheel bundles CUDA (for example torch), so the step can use its GPU; on a plain base image also set ENV LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/nvidia/lib64:/usr/local/nvidia/lib and ENV PATH=/usr/local/nvidia/bin:${PATH}. This check is a heuristic: it searches the image and the dependency files.

rules.name: TooLongNotResumable
rules.fix: Make the step resumable (resumable=True, saving checkpoints with kaos_lib.checkpoint) or set walltime to the longest run or less.

rules.name: TooLongBeyondContinuations
rules.fix: Shorten walltime, or split the work into steps that each fit within the runs allowed.

rules.name: UnknownClass
rules.fix: Pin one of the classes your project offers (the step's class dropdown lists them), or remove the pin.

rules.name: ClientIdentity
rules.fix: Remove it: the platform chooses the account every step runs as and places the pod. Use step(...) arguments and compute classes instead.

rules.name: DependencyOrProducer
rules.fix: Define each step before the steps that need it, pass the step variables in needs=[...], give each step a unique lowercase name, and read only sections that exist in config/.

rules.name: RefusedArgument
rules.fix: Fix the argument as the message says; step() raises on it when the pipeline is rendered.

rules.name: StepDeclaration
rules.fix: Give every step a kind, name its dataset inputs in inputs=[...] and what it writes in produces=[...].

rules.name: StepNotMoved
rules.fix: Move the step to kaos_lib.step: step.start() gives the config and the run, step.input() the datasets, step.result() hands values on. Guide: https://storage.googleapis.com/kaos-dev-511509-kaos-lib/docs/migrate-to-0.5.html

rules.name: NodeSharing
rules.fix: Nothing to fix. Set walltime, for example walltime='4h', to let the step share a node.

rules.name: LearnedLimits
rules.fix: Nothing to fix. A limit of 2 hours or more is kept exactly as you set it.

rules.name: Schedules
rules.fix: Nothing to fix.

rules.name: LongGpuStepNotResumable
rules.fix: Make the step resumable (resumable=True, saving checkpoints with kaos_lib.checkpoint), or shorten walltime.

rules.name: IdleTimeoutOff
rules.fix: Remove idle_timeout=0 to keep the default (a step with no GPU use and no new log line for 20 minutes is ended), or raise it, for example idle_timeout='40m'.

rules.name: UnpinnedDataset
rules.fix: Pin a version: use <dataset>@v1 (a released version) instead of @latest, so a run always reads the same data.

rules.name: NoMlflowOrModelNotRegistered
rules.fix: Log the run to MLflow in the training step (kaos_lib.mlflow.mlflow()) and register the model you keep. This check is a heuristic: it searches the step's code.

rules.name: DeclaredResumableDidNotResume
rules.fix: Make the step load its checkpoint and continue from it: save into $KAOS_CHECKPOINT_DIR (or with kaos_lib.checkpoint) and load it when the step starts, so a continuation gets past the checkpoint it started from.
